summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of TransferNews.de sport1.de-style layout redesign. All major features working correctly: two-tier header (white + green nav), hero teaser with gradient overlay and breaking badge, newsticker sidebar with green time badges, hamburger menu on mobile, search with autosuggest, news detail page, footer with all links, breaking news ticker animation, and ad slots strategically placed.
passed_tests: Homepage loads correctly with sport1.de-style layout
Two-tier header: white top bar with logo + green navigation bar
Logo displays correctly: TRANSFER (black) + NEWS (green #79B92A)
Burger menu button visible and functional
Hamburger menu opens with all navigation items (TRANSFERS, NEWS, GERÜCHTE, BUNDESLIGA, PREMIER LEAGUE, LA LIGA, Admin-Bereich)
Green sports navigation bar with all links working
Hero teaser with gradient overlay displays correctly
Breaking badge (red) shows on hero teaser
Newsticker sidebar with green time badges (sport1.de style)
Breaking news ticker (red background) animates correctly
Search input with autosuggest functionality working
Mobile search button opens search bar
Mobile newsticker section displays correctly
News list page (/news) loads with newsticker entries
News detail page loads with article content
Share buttons (Facebook, X, WhatsApp, Email) present on detail page
Back link on detail page works
Footer displays with all sections (NEWS, WETTBEWERBE, RECHTLICHES)
Footer social media icons (Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube) present
21 footer links present
Navigation to Gerüchte page works
Navigation to Bundesliga page works
Ad slots strategically placed (11 found on homepage)
Sidebar ad slots (3) properly positioned
Mobile layout responsive and functional
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sport1.de-style layout redesign complete and verified. All navigation, header structure, newsticker sidebar, breaking news ticker, search, and ad slots working correctly. Mobile hamburger menu functional. Footer has all required links and social icons.
